title: Federal Contracts & Grants by Company input

companies.title: Companies (names or UEIs)
companies.description: Company names (e.g. "Booz Allen Hamilton", "Palantir") or 12-character SAM.gov UEIs (e.g. "JCBMLGPE6Z71"). Names are matched strictly: every word must appear in the recipient name, so all subsidiaries that share the name are included. Leave empty to search by filters only.

awardTypes.title: Award types
awardTypes.description: Which awards to return: contracts (definitive contracts, purchase orders, delivery orders), idvs (GSA schedules, GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs), grants, loans. Default contracts.

lookbackDays.title: Look back (days)
lookbackDays.description: Awards with activity in the last N days (default 365). Ignored when startDate is set.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: Optional start of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (earliest 2007-10-01). Overrides lookbackDays.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Optional end of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

maxAwardsPerCompany.title: Max awards per company
maxAwardsPerCompany.description: Most award rows per company (or for a filters-only search), 1-5000, default 100. Each row is one charged record.

sortBy.title: Sort awards by
sortBy.description: Return the largest awards first (default) or the newest first.

includeSummary.title: Add a company summary row
includeSummary.description: Add one company_summary row per company: matched recipient names and UEIs, total obligated in the period, top awarding agencies and top NAICS codes. Counts as one record. Default true.

strictNameMatch.title: Strict name matching
strictNameMatch.description: Keep only recipients whose name contains every word of your query (default true). USAspending's own name search is fuzzy and returns unrelated companies; turn this off only to see everything it returns.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Optional: only awards whose description or fields match these words, e.g. "cybersecurity", "cloud migration" (3+ characters each).

agencies.title: Awarding agencies
agencies.description: Optional top-tier awarding agency names exactly as USAspending writes them, e.g. "Department of Defense", "Department of Veterans Affairs", "General Services Administration".

naicsCodes.title: NAICS codes
naicsCodes.description: Optional NAICS codes or prefixes (2-6 digits), e.g. "541512" or "5415".

pscCodes.title: PSC codes
pscCodes.description: Optional Product and Service Codes, e.g. "DA01" or "R425" (contracts and IDVs only).

states.title: Place of performance states
states.description: Optional 2-letter US state codes for where the work is done, e.g. "VA", "CA".

minAmount.title: Minimum award amount (USD)
minAmount.description: Optional: skip awards smaller than this amount.

maxCompanies.title: Max companies per run
maxCompanies.description: Safety cap on companies processed in one run (default 200).

datasetId.title: Dataset ID
datasetId.description: Optional: read company names from another Actor's dataset (e.g. a lead list). The name field is auto-detected (companyName, company, organization, legalName, name, uei) or set companyField.

companyField.title: Company field
companyField.description: Field in that dataset holding the company name or UEI. Dot paths work (e.g. company.name).

datasetMaxItems.title: Max companies from dataset
datasetMaxItems.description: Most companies read from the dataset (default 100).
